scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i sidepanel.css -o dist/sidepanel.css --minify && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.build:web: node scripts/clean.mjs www && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir www && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i sidepanel.css -o www/sidepanel.css --minify && node scripts/copy-web.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && cap open ios
